scope: Read-only review of current smoke partition integration and narrow compiler evidence/fuzz follow-on. No tests, edits, or heavy runs.
evidence: smoke-partition.ts recursively enumerates every discovered spec/test pair, refuses discovery errors/duplicate or empty identities, and assigns each native identity by index modulo the partition count. For the complete six-entry matrix, the partitions are disjoint and exhaustive over the same complete discovery ordering.

Generated --test-list syntax matches the installed Playwright parser at node_modules/playwright/lib/runner/index.js:2709: project, relative filename and complete title path. Native parser permits title prefixes, but the second discovery verification detects both extra and missing identities, including ambiguous selectors, before seed or execution.

smoke.sh preserves identical caller filters for complete discovery, selected rediscovery and execution, refuses simultaneous shard/test-list partition filters, and rewrites NOVA_E2E_DISCOVERY_MANIFEST to the verified selected discovery before e2e/seed.ts. set -euo pipefail prevents selection failures from becoming partial green runs.

e2e/lib/scenarioSeeds.ts consumes selected spec IDs plus project retry/repeat metadata, so fixture attempt identities continue matching the selected actual test IDs. CI project definitions public/authed have no dependency-project expansion; the six matrix jobs select the same two projects.
ci.yml retains fail-fast:false, all six partitions and aggregate smoke gate, while --fail-on-flaky-tests makes successful retry insufficient for a green run.

compilerEvidence uses Buffer.equals for complete byte-content equality, explicitly refuses absent fixture bytes, and expects true so an absent archive entry still fails. Both fuzz generators retain exact 400 and 500 runs, their seed, shrinking helper, and census assertions; only time budgets change from 30 to 60 seconds.
limits: Root-reported native all-228 exact-once rediscovery across six partitions and live harness/fuzz results were not rerun by this reviewer.
Complete six-partition CI runtime and total wall-clock performance remain root-owned live gates; round-robin distribution alone does not guarantee a duration ceiling.
followonReview: Re-read final workflow diff: smoke display count, complete matrix [1,2,3,4,5,6], and SMOKE_PARTITION denominator all consistently six; unchanged algorithm and aggregate gate. No actionable finding. No tests rerun.
ownerReportedFollowonEvidence: Root verified all 228 native test identities exactly once across six selected discovery lists, each containing 38 tests.
Root completed actual 1/5 harness run with 46 passes; this validates the unchanged parameterized partition integration but is not claimed as a six-partition full runtime execution.
Root reran both complete fuzz corpora: 900 samples, two tests passed in 22.27 seconds.
